hints.title: One cell at a time
hints.body: Determine where a single cell lands after a quarter turn.

hints.title: Coordinate mapping
hints.body: The cell at `(r, c)` moves to `(c, n - 1 - r)`.

hints.title: Use a fresh matrix
hints.body: Writing into a new matrix avoids overwriting values that have not been moved yet.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
n = number of rows
result = n by n matrix
for r from 0 to n - 1:
    for c from 0 to n - 1:
        result[c][n - 1 - r] = matrix[r][c]
return result
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
